why: Everything a learner downloads to open the app: the page, the one script and the service worker. The script is 544 kB raw and 165 kB gzipped, and 370 kB of it (114 kB gzipped) is React's DOM renderer, which cannot be split smaller; the other 174 kB is the shell's own code and the libraries it validates with. That is over the 500 kB at which the build warns about a single chunk, so the budget is stated here, above it, rather than the warning silenced: the figure that crosses the link is the gzipped total, 167 kB, which is about 3.3 s on a 3G link of 400 kbit/s and under 1 s at 1.6 Mbit/s. The budget leaves 2.0% (raw) and 2.0% (gzipped) of room above the baseline; raising it is an edit to this file's baseline, with a reason. M7 Track H2 raised it from a baseline of 508,776 raw and 155,457 gzipped (M6-58) to the figures above: +13.6 kB raw and +3.9 kB gzipped (2.7% and 2.5%). Resuming from the device and from the server's log (the stored offset, the merge, the wall-clock port) cost 2.6 kB raw and 0.7 kB gzipped (measured on its own commit); the home, practice and report screens, their request hooks and the schemas that validate what Learning answers cost the remaining 11 kB raw and 3.1 kB gzipped. The screens are in the one script because the budget is about what crosses the link to open the app, and a learner who is sent to a report or a practice run would otherwise pay a second round trip to open it. M8 Track D (M8-15) moved the response log from `localStorage` to IndexedDB with strict durability and raised the baseline from 522,414 raw and 159,314 gzipped to the figures above: +16.0 kB raw and +4.9 kB gzipped (3.1% each). That is the store, its group-commit writer, the move of an earlier build's records, and the words for answers not yet saved or not kept; a row per event rather than one record rewritten each time is what keeps the cost of a write from growing with the attempt. M8 Track E (M8-22) added the onboarding flow and raised the baseline from 538,370 raw and 164,197 gzipped to the figures above: +10.1 kB raw and +3.2 kB gzipped (1.9% and 2.0%). That is the profile calls and the schemas that validate what Learning answers, the draft kept on the device in the response log's database (a second object store, and the upgrade that adds it without touching the log), the screen and its questions, the way back to the chapters when the syllabus has moved on, and the invitation on the home screen. The earlier text gave the shell's code as 148 kB and the figure over the link as 159 kB; those were the figures from before M7 Track H2, never brought up to date by the two raises since, and are corrected here from a build. M8 Track F (M8-24) moved the baseline from 548,510 raw and 167,406 gzipped to the figures above: +2.5 kB raw and +0.6 kB gzipped (0.5% and 0.4%). That is sitting a practice run: its package schema and loader, the boot that brings a run up, the session taking no deadline, and the run's labels on the screen a paper is sat on. The screen, the session, the writer and the verification are the paper's and were not copied, which is why a second way of delivering questions cost so little. M8 Track G (M8-29) moved the baseline from 551,040 raw and 168,019 gzipped to the figures above: +6.8 kB raw and +1.9 kB gzipped (1.2% and 1.1%), and the budget with it, to 2.0% above. That is the screen for where the learner stands and the one for the answers behind a topic, the three reads they and the home and report screens make of Learning (the map, a topic's answers, and what topics are called) with the schemas that validate them, the words for a standing that is too early to say, and the loader that names the topics a screen is handed. It is also a saving: the address parameters, the profile and taxonomy the screens used to read off the address and carry from screen to screen, and the label built from an identifier, are gone. M8 Track H (M8-32, M8-33) moved the baseline from 557,794 raw and 169,943 gzipped to the figures above: +4.4 kB raw and +1.1 kB gzipped (0.8% and 0.7%), and the budget with it, to 2.0% above. That is the diagnostic's offer on the home screen and the tap that starts it, the word the practice screen tells a learner about an answer with the sentence it says when it cannot, the control that adds questions to a run, the three calls those make, and the small module that gives up on a slow request. M8 Track J (M8-42, M8-43) moved the baseline from 562,238 raw and 171,078 gzipped to the figures above: +9.0 kB raw and +2.5 kB gzipped (1.6% and 1.4%), and the budget with it, to 2.0% above. That is the way in: the sign-in, create-an-account, check-your-mail, confirm-an-address, recovery and new-password screens, the gate that decides which a person sees and the sign-out control, the calls they make, the reading of a link from a message, and the typed client's two new options (cookies and a header added to every request). Nothing was removed to pay for it; the token read from `localStorage` was one line. M8 Track K (M8-47, M8-48, M8-49) moved the baseline from 571,256 raw and 173,540 gzipped to the figures above: +22.9 kB raw and +8.0 kB gzipped (4.0% and 4.6%), and the budget with it, to 2.0% above. Almost all of it is one dependency: the security audit required `zod` 4.6.6 or later (memory exhaustion validating oversized collections), and 4.6.7 is 22 kB larger than the 4.4.3 it replaced, in the code that validates every answer from the server. The track's own additions are small and were not measured apart: the session-status read and its reason, the sentence on the sign-in screen, and about 0.4 kB of stylesheet in the page for the 44-pixel floor on controls (WCAG 2.2 target size). Nothing was removed to pay for it; a smaller validation library or a pinned older `zod` would, and the older one has the advisory. M8 Track M (M8-57) moved the baseline from 594,166 raw and 181,557 gzipped to the figures above: +1.0 kB raw and +0.3 kB gzipped (0.2% each), and the budget with it, to 2.0% above. That is the wait before a sign-in is said to be taking a moment, the sentence it says, and the one retry of a busy refusal.
